subject: ArmPkg: Remove branch prediction control APIs
reasons: Removes a few call sites (ArmCallSEV, ArmBranchPredictionBarrier calls in CpuPei.c) and the assembly implementation in AArch64Support.S
The removal affects only 2 files with a small number of call sites; this is a targeted cleanup, not a widespread pattern
Paired with 2a7edc37c3 (MdePkg header removal), but together they are still a low-repetition, API-deletion scenario rather than a migration Coccinelle is suited for
